question_summary: Contractor requests approval to substitute ABS DWV piping for the specified no-hub cast-iron soil piping (Section 22 13 16) prior to ordering material and beginning fixture rough-in.
proposed_solution: Use ABS DWV piping in lieu of no-hub cast-iron soil piping.
deadline_text: Please respond by the end of the week
